label: Diagram 9.5
caption: Diagram 9.5 | Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors | Fire‐stopping
description: 'See para 9.23' is at the top left, and a green bar along the bottom reads 'Diagram 9.5 Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors'. The drawing has two parts. Part a, headed 'a. Flue passing through compartment wall or floor', shows two upright grey rectangles with a horizontal grey band attached to the left of the left rectangle at a lower level and a horizontal grey flue between the two rectangles at a higher level. A label 'Compartment wall or floor' points to the left horizontal band, 'Flue' to the horizontal flue, and 'Flue wall' to the right upright rectangle. Explanatory text sits below. Part b, headed 'b. Flue built into compartment wall', shows two side-by-side plans, each a horizontal grey band with a hollow square grey block on it; in the left-hand plan the band is level and the square is centred on it, while in the right-hand plan the square sits on the higher left part of the band, which steps lower on the right side. Each plan is labelled 'Compartment wall', pointing to the band. Explanatory text sits below.
